summary: Executed backend+frontend verification for the reported template/image modal fix, new font-size control behavior, admin decoration/template workflows, and updated 6-basic-template regression expectations.

ui_bugs.issue: Weight/style/size controls are not perfectly aligned on one row by control bounding-box top; measured Y-offsets remained (customer mobile 390x844: ~14px, admin desktop: ~9px).
Console repeatedly logs React warning 'Encountered two children with the same key' while running admin decoration/template flow.

integration_issues.issue: After saving draft and clicking [data-testid='template-editor-back'], route returned to product info tab; automation expecting template-list pane timed out. Behavior may be intentional but should be clarified for UX/testability.

issues: Font size field appears visually lower than weight/style controls; does not satisfy strict same-row alignment intent from user requirement.

action_items: Adjust CSS/grid alignment so weight, style, and size input top/baseline align in one row for both customer and admin editors.
Investigate duplicate React key warnings in admin decoration/template UI lists and ensure stable unique keys per rendered sibling list.
Clarify/confirm intended destination of template-editor-back (product info vs template list); update UX or test hook accordingly.
Optional: run additional manual WebKit-specific verification for template modal layout if a WebKit runtime is available in environment.
critical_code_review_comments: Outdated 40-template regression expectation was still present in test_studio_phase1_regression.py; updated to approved 6 basics and own-template coexistence checks.
Template modal overlap/cropping regression appears fixed: across 320/390/844-landscape/768/1024/1440, cards did not overlap, image naturalWidth>0, object-fit=contain, and final row remained visible.

Font-size validation behavior is correct functionally: preset 32, manual 27, decimal 24.5 apply; invalid <4/>200/non-numeric do not mutate canvas; oversize in-bounds check triggers existing error and keeps last valid design state.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 tests passed across iteration18 templates/decorations + phase1 regression suite after expectation update)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% (priority user bug fixed and most controls/flows passed; alignment+console issues remain)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_UI* admin decoration/template fixtures during UI testing; cleaned up by deleting TEST_UI-prefixed records from MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified explicit user bug: template picker cards/images are fully visible and non-overlapping across requested responsive sizes including mobile landscape; search + replace confirm/cancel + undo still work. Verified no [data-testid='font-example'], size dropdown/input logic works in customer and admin editors. Remaining concern is strict one-row vertical alignment requirement and duplicate-key console warnings in admin flow. WebKit-specific run was not executed in this container tooling.
rca of the issue: Row-alignment issue likely originates from mixed control box metrics in .curated-variants/.font-size-combobox styles (different margins/padding/line-heights), causing size input top offset versus weight/style selects. Duplicate-key warning indicates at least one rendered sibling list receives non-unique key values during admin flow refresh; likely list hydration/state merge timing around decoration/template reloads.
